mentions.name: The Marvelous Brass Chessplaying Automaton
mentions.description: A chess database, playing, and opening-training app for Apple platforms with an Apple-native GUI and iCloud sync between devices. It supports repertoire management and spaced-repetition opening memorisation, and implements human-like computer opponents at all levels using a transformer-based model (similar to the Maia 3 paper) combined with a very small search. It also covers chess variants: a companion Apple Watch app for 5x5 chess, a 10x10 chess Easter egg game, and work in progress on hexagonal chess.
mentions.problem: Existing chess tools like ChessBase lack an Apple-native GUI and iCloud sync, and for chess variants there are no large databases of human games to train on, making weak-but-enjoyable opponent levels challenging to implement.

mentions.name: The Marvelous Brass Chessplaying Automaton
mentions.description: A native chess app for Apple platforms, supporting iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Apple Watch with a visionOS port planned. It offers a native Apple look and feel, iCloud sync, and is designed to serve chess players from club players to professionals, including use for chess training.
mentions.problem: There is no Apple-native chess app comparable to ChessBase, and the author is frustrated by the trend of macOS apps built with Electron or other cross-platform frameworks instead of native toolkits.
mentions.audience: Aims to satisfy chess players from club level to professionals; the author also uses it for personal chess training.
